hud.ready.title: Ready
hud.ready.hint: Hold Y to start recording, or press Menu to open the panel.
hud.intro.title: Notes
hud.intro.tips:
• Keep your hands, body and your reflection out of the shots
• Move slowly and steadily, and pause briefly for each photo
• Photograph each spot from several angles and heights
• Hold Y for 3 seconds to go to the next step
hud.step1.title: Step 1 - Scan the structure
hud.step1.hint: Pre-scan the room's structure and build a guide map. No photos are taken in this step.
hud.step1.tips:
• Look around slowly until the balls cover the walls, floor and ceiling
• Stay about a metre away from surfaces
• Make sure everything is covered, including corners and around furniture
hud.step2.title: Step 2 - Photograph the room
hud.step2.hint: Capture the room. Turn as many balls green as you can, and move on whenever you are happy.
hud.step2.tips:
• Pull the trigger to take one photo / Hold the grip to take photos continuously
• Each ball lights up on the side it has been photographed from
• Orange: not enough angles. Green: enough angles. Blue: all angles covered, with a close-up
hud.step3.title: Step 3 - Detail shots
hud.step3.hint: Add detail shots of objects as you like. Finish whenever you are happy.
hud.step3.tips:
• Pull the trigger to take one photo / Hold the grip to take photos continuously
• Nearby surfaces you have photographed are covered by a blue point cloud
